algorithm_title: Develop an algorithm enabling autonomous drones to coordinate movement while avoiding collisions.
evidence_summary: This suite provides limited behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with partial termination evidence. The reference is graphical/stateful and has no stdout result representing collision avoidance.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: termination behaviour.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as agreement for the specific exercised scenario or scenarios, not as strong evidence of general behavioural equivalence.
coverage_limitations: The reference is graphical/stateful and has no stdout result representing collision avoidance.
A startup/termination test cannot establish collision-avoidance correctness.
Meaningful behavioural validation requires state-snapshot assertions over drone positions, velocities, target transitions and obstacle distances.
manual_review_targets: Review obstacle-avoidance, swarm-update and target-transition state semantics.
Treat visual rendering itself as non-semantic unless it changes simulation state.

tests.name: headless simulation initialisation and bounded execution

semantic_test.reason: The semantic contract is available to the integrated human review, but no safe generic automatic invocation/observer is declared for this task in Common Tests v1.2.

semantic_contract.task_statement: Develop algorithms enabling autonomous drones to coordinate movement while avoiding collisions.

result.canonical_semantics: All drones reach the destination while maintaining collision-avoidance constraints.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

boundary_evaluation_policy.core_score_separation: Boundary probes do not contribute to core semantic behavioural accuracy or Common Test accuracy.
boundary_evaluation_policy.interpretation: If enabled, variance is the percentage of evaluable out-of-domain probes that the implementation accepts and processes.
